about: v4 (14 Oct): questions for the news-at-release engine (news.py, NEWS=1). Written before any news data was fetched. Films chosen because Wikipedia documents (or clearly does not document) a link between news events and the release; n06 and n08 are controls where a stated link at release is not expected, so a good answer calls topic matches coincidence.

questions.question: Did anything happening in the news help The China Syndrome at the box office?
questions.notes: Says what was in the news; calls a link 'stated' only if a quoted source states it (e.g. the Three Mile Island accident, if the context has it); no causal claim from headlines alone.

questions.question: Was Wag the Dog's success connected to what was in the news at the time?
questions.notes: Separates headlines that match the film's topic from a link a source states; gives the film's own box-office numbers with sources.

questions.question: How did the September 11 attacks affect Zoolander's release and box office?
questions.notes: Uses only what the context says about 9/11 and the film; says plainly if the context does not state an effect.

questions.question: Did the news around Black Hawk Down's release play a role in how it did?
questions.notes: Mentions the news at release from the headlines with dates; does not claim causation unless a source states it.

questions.question: Was Tenet hurt by what was going on in the world when it came out?
questions.notes: Uses the pandemic only as far as the context documents it; keeps numbers with sources.

questions.question: What was in the news when Jaws came out, and did it matter for the film?
questions.notes: Control: lists news of the time; without a stated link, calls any topic match a coincidence and uses the cross-film figure if given.

questions.question: Did the political climate help or hurt Collateral Damage?
questions.notes: States the release timing and any documented delay only if the context has it; no invented causes.

questions.question: Was Contagion's box office linked to news events when it was released?
questions.notes: Control: the 2020 pandemic is after the 2011 release; must not present later events as news at release.
